name: Black Shield Metals Corp.
summary: Black Shield Metals Corp., an exploration stage company, engages in the acquisition, exploration, development, and mining of mineral properties in Canada. It has an option agreement to acquire interests in the carbonate hosted gold project located in British Columbia. The company was formerly known as ZP Mining Inc. and changed its name to Black Shield Metals Corp. in February 2020. Black Shield Metals Corp. was incorporated in 2017 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
